name: Search/last-updated
description: _lastUpdated search-parameter conformance tests against a single server-assigned-id Patient: single-bound ge/lt assertions, AND-by-repetition over a broad range, and a contradictory repeated-bound case whose result is implementation-defined.

variable.name: responseId
variable.description: Server-assigned id for the fixture patient

operation.description: POST Patient to establish the fixture with a server-assigned lastUpdated timestamp

test.name: _lastUpdated ge2000 with suite identifier returns the fixture
test.description: GET /Patient?identifier=...|LAST-UPDATED-PAT1&_lastUpdated=ge2000 must return HTTP 200, a searchset Bundle, and must include the fixture by both its resource id and its suite identifier. The fixture was just created so its meta.lastUpdated is certainly on or after 2000.

assert.description: Must include one entry whose resource has both the fixture id and suite identifier system and value

test.name: _lastUpdated lt2000 with suite identifier returns empty bundle
test.description: GET /Patient?identifier=...|LAST-UPDATED-PAT1&_lastUpdated=lt2000 must return HTTP 200 and a searchset Bundle with no match entries. The fixture was created in this century and cannot have a lastUpdated timestamp before year 2000.

assert.description: Match entries must be empty: the fixture was created no earlier than the year 2000 and cannot have a lastUpdated before that

test.name: repeated _lastUpdated ge2000 and lt2999 (broad AND range) contains the fixture
test.description: GET /Patient?identifier=...|LAST-UPDATED-PAT1&_lastUpdated=ge2000&_lastUpdated=lt2999 exercises the AND-by-repetition convention for a range that comfortably contains the fixture's lastUpdated. Hard HTTP 200/Bundle/searchset asserts confirm the server responded correctly; the fixture-membership assert is warningOnly because the FHIR specification does not normatively require servers to AND repeated search parameter keys — server behavior for unprofiled repeated-key semantics varies.

assert.description: One entry matching both the fixture id and suite identifier should appear when the server ANDs repeated _lastUpdated values over the range ge2000 to lt2999; warningOnly because the FHIR specification does not normatively profile AND semantics for repeated search parameter keys and server behavior varies

test.name: contradictory repeated _lastUpdated ge2000 and lt2000 yields empty match
test.description: GET /Patient?identifier=...|LAST-UPDATED-PAT1&_lastUpdated=ge2000&_lastUpdated=lt2000 combines a lower bound and an equal upper bound that together admit no instants. Hard HTTP 200/Bundle/searchset asserts confirm the server responded correctly; the empty-match assert is warningOnly because the FHIR specification does not normatively require AND semantics for repeated search parameter keys — some servers may apply OR or last-wins semantics and return results.

assert.description: Match entries should be empty: a contradictory range (ge2000 AND lt2000) admits no instants when ANDed; warningOnly because the FHIR specification does not normatively require AND semantics for repeated search parameter keys and some servers may apply OR or last-wins semantics

operation.description: Teardown: delete the fixture patient created by this run
